31411.s: The bill establishes an independent administrative body, the College voor examens, to take over the national exam tasks previously carried out by ministry units and the state exam committees, and amends the education supervision and secondary education acts accordingly. The college sets exam content, procedures and assessment, and the minister appoints its members on nominations from representative organisations, with inspectorate oversight of its functioning.
31411.j: The memorandum justifies the arrangement by pointing to the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen framework, the need for expert exam content, and stakeholder involvement, while retaining ministerial responsibility for supervision of schools and exams.
q: The minister also retains responsibility for supervising schools and examinations.
Ook behoudt de minister de verantwoordelijkheid voor het uitoefenen van toezicht op de scholen en de examens.
d: college sets exam number, timing, form, assessment norms and tool rules
other tasks assigned by the minister to the college
entry into force by royal decree on staggered dates
p: The minister appoints, promotes, suspends and dismisses the college's staff after consultation with the chair, giving the executive personnel control over the body's secretariat.
The inspectorate is given new supervisory powers over the college's functioning and compliance, with intervention as a last resort.

parties: Asks whether the minister's material steering powers over the College will be sufficient, given that dismissal and annulment powers are blunt tools and steering through agreements alone has failed elsewhere.

These members ask the government whether, despite the safeguards built into the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies, the minister's material steering powers over quality will not be too limited.

Deze leden vragen de regering of, ondanks de in de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen ingebouwde waarborgen, in materiële zin de sturingsmogelijkheden van de minister op kwaliteit niet te gering zullen zijn.
Warns that the College could become a source of 'phantom legislation' outside parliament and asks which safeguards prevent a repeat of the KCE failure and what instruments the minister keeps.
They ask the government whether it recognises the danger that the College for Examinations becomes a source of phantom legislation outside parliament, from which schools could suffer greatly.
Zij vragen de regering of deze het gevaar onderkent dat het College voor examens een bron van fantoomwetgeving buiten het parlement zal worden, waarvan de scholen veel last kunnen krijgen.
Critical of creating a new zelfstandig bestuursorgaan and asks why the ministry should not steer the institutes directly, whether the minister can also supervise, and which zbo type is chosen.
They are critical of the establishment of a new independent administrative body (zbo).
Zij zijn kritisch over de oprichting van een nieuw zelfstandig bestuursorgaan (zbo).
Asks why the government chose not to include independent experts in the board to safeguard the civil effect of diplomas, and why the College's role is limited to secondary education.
To safeguard the civil effect of the examination, however, the government has not chosen to also seat independent experts on the board alongside the stakeholder organisations.

Ter borging van het civiel effect van het examen heeft de regering er evenwel niet voor gekozen om, naast de belangenorganisaties, tevens onafhankelijke deskundigen zitting te laten nemen in het bestuur.
Questions the justification for linking broader stakeholder participation to ending the dual responsibility structure and asks for clearer criteria for representativeness.
These members find the government's explanation on that point rather vague and leaving much room open.
Deze leden vinden dat de toelichting van de regering op dat punt betrekkelijk vaag is en veel ruimte openlaat.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against establishing the College voor examens as a zbo without first weighing the loss of parliamentary control, and asked that the tasks be set out in the law itself and that the NT2 state examinations be included. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the advice: it clarified the division of responsibilities, moved the tasks into article 2, added the NT2 examinations, but deferred their transfer by a year and rejected the claim that participation weakens control.
concerns: The Afdeling said the proposal does not show that the benefits of verzelfstandiging outweigh reduced Staten-Generaal control, and the government argued the kaderwet instruments and parliamentary reporting preserve control.
The Afdeling objected that the tasks of the college were to be assigned by algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than set in the law, and the government moved the tasks into article 2 of the bill.

The Afdeling questioned the necessity of the zbo form given the existing CEVO and Staatsexamencommissie, and the government responded by clarifying the responsibilities and the participation interest.
The Afdeling recommended including the NT2 state examinations in the college, and the government accepted the scope change but postponed the actual transfer by about one year.
The Afdeling gave redactional comments in an annex, which the government adopted.

31501.s: The bill consolidates and harmonises the provisions on handling of products in the Air Pollution Act, the Noise Nuisance Act and title 10.3 of the Environmental Management Act into a new title 9.5 of chapter 9 of the Environmental Management Act, and repeals the older provisions. It also extends chapter 9 and title 8.2 to activities and installations within the Dutch exclusive economic zone where an order in council so provides.
31501.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical simplification and harmonisation needed to implement EU REACH and noise directives, and to adapt rules quickly to practice through ministerial regulation.
q: This leaves the dozens of orders in council (see section 2) and the ministerial regulations based on them (see the commentary on article V) as such untouched.
Dit laat de tientallen amvb's (zie paragraaf 2) en daarop gebaseerde ministeriële regelingen (zie de toelichting op artikel V) echter als zodanig ongemoeid.
d: rules on manufacture, import, possession, supply, transport and use of designated products to prevent air pollution or noise nuisance
rules on handling, recycling and disposal of designated substances, preparations and products for waste management and environmental protection
allowing the competent authority to deviate from product rules when granting or amending environmental permits
temporary ministerial regulation for up to two years where urgent provision is needed
exemptions from prohibitions and obligations, by royal decree for defence and by the minister otherwise, with attached conditions
I.D (art. 9.5.1, achtste lid; art. 9.5.2, zevende lid)
further detailed rules on matters regulated in an order in council
extending title 8.2 and chapter 9 to activities and installations within the exclusive economic zone
p: Replaces many specific statutory product rules with a broad framework allowing the executive to regulate by order in council the manufacture, sale and use of designated products and substances, with the explanatory memorandum noting that the earlier open delegation was rejected in favour of this structure.

Allows an order in council to permit the competent permitting authority to deviate from product rules when granting or amending environmental permits, limited to categories of cases the order specifies.
Lets the minister adopt a ministerial regulation of up to two years in urgent cases, bypassing the order-in-council procedure, with a fixed maximum duration.
Gives the minister and the Crown discretion to grant, attach conditions to, amend and withdraw exemptions from product rules on defence and other grounds.
Extends environmental regulation into the exclusive economic zone by order in council, which the explanatory memorandum says requires restraint.
I.E-M (repeal of arts. 10.15-10.20 Wm, 13-18, 86, 88 Wlv and related provisions)

Removes the special procedure for amvb under the Air Pollution Act (voorhang, voorpublicatie, nahang) and the licence-behind-prohibition mechanism, which the bill says is replaced by the new framework and transitional rules.

parties: Asks why the bill was delayed and whether the proposed structure and product rules are sound; raises questions on enforcement in the EEZ and on dated national decrees.
The members attach great value to the underlying aim of modernising and recalibrating regulation and therefore note this delay with concern and ask the reason for it.

De leden hechten grote waarde aan het onderliggende doel, modernisering en herijking van regelgeving en nemen daarom met zorg kennis van deze vertraging van dit proces en vragen naar de reden hiervan.

Warns that modernisation must not weaken protection of nature, environment and health; doubts the removal of national AMvB rules and the exclusion of national delegation grounds, and asks about the role of both chambers.
Why does the government explicitly exclude national legal bases for further rules by AMvB?
Waarom sluit de regering expliciet nationale grondslagen voor nadere regels bij AMvB uit?
Asks whether and how AMvB and ministerial regulations under the new delegation articles are submitted to the House and what consultation procedure applies.
First, these members want to know whether and how possible AMvB and ministerial regulations based on articles 9.5.1 and 9.5.2 will be submitted to the House.
Ten eerste willen deze leden weten of en op welke wijze mogelijke AMvB's en ministeriële regelingen die hun grondslag vinden in de artikelen 9.5.1 en 9.5.2 worden voorgelegd aan de Kamer.

v.summary: The Council of State advised on a bill consolidating environmental noise and air pollution product rules into Chapter 9 of the Environmental Management Act, recommending clarifications on definitions, ministerial regulation powers, aircraft, inspection bodies, defence exemptions, a catch-all provision and transitional law. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points, amending the bill accordingly while declining some editorial remarks.
concerns: Ministerial regulations under the bill were insufficiently bounded and essential rules should be in an general administrative order; the government confined the power and limited ministerial regulation to technical matters.
Definitions of noise, noise nuisance and air pollution were placed in the general definitions article and the air pollution definition was aligned with the Air Pollution Act exclusions.
Council asked for a planning of further integration phases and for a more coherent exemption procedure for defence, which the government added to the explanatory memorandum and amended.
The catch-all provision and the delegation for inspection bodies were revised and an explicit legal basis for appointing inspection bodies was added.

Transitional law should have one reference moment, which the government adopted, while several editorial remarks on cross-references were not adopted because the amending laws would enter into force earlier.

31792-G.s: The bill amends the 2008 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the BTW-compensatiefonds, increasing expenditure and receipts by 110,343 thousand euros under a supplementary budget linked to the autumn budget memorandum (Najaarsnota). It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force at 1 December 2008.
q: The budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds for the year 2008 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het BTW-compensatiefonds voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

31965-E.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the AOW savings fund (Spaarfonds AOW) in connection with the Spring Memorandum, approving a first supplementary budget with changed expenditure and receipts figures in thousands of euros. It sets the amended budget's effective date as 1 June 2009 with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement of the AOW savings fund for 2009 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Spaarfonds AOW voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32014.s: The bill lowers the thresholds for disclosing shareholding in listed companies from five to three percent, requires shareholders at or above three percent to state whether they object to the company's published strategy, and obliges custodians and intermediaries to disclose investor identities on request. It also lowers the Civil Code shareholder threshold for placing agenda items on the general meeting to three percent and removes the market-value alternative.
32014.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation powers as needed to set form requirements and transmission rules for identification requests.
q: By ministerial regulation, rules may be laid down on how a request under the first, fourth or seventh paragraph is made and answered.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de wijze waarop een verzoek op grond van het eerste, vierde of zevende lid wordt gedaan en beantwoord.
d: procedures for identification requests and responses
manner of shareholder requests and company forwarding of information
p: Enforcement of identification duties runs through civil court orders rather than administrative supervision, and suspension of voting rights is available as a remedy.

parties: Asks about long-term shareholder incentives, empty voting, the Council of State's criticism, and whether group shareholders can still set agenda items via a 3% threshold.
Can the government estimate how shareholders will react to (massive) changes in intentions?
Kan de regering een inschatting geven van de wijze waarop aandeelhouders zullen reageren op (massale) veranderingen in de intenties?

Questions raising the agenda threshold from 1% to 3%, arguing it could mean boards and supervisory boards no longer have to account for their policy, and questions the status of the Council of State's objections on shareholder identification.
Does the government share the view that the intention cannot be that boards and supervisory directors no longer have to account for the policy they pursue?
Deelt de regering de mening dat het niet de bedoeling kan zijn dat raden van bestuur en commissarissen geen verantwoording meer hoeven af te leggen over het door hun gevoerde beleid?

Welcomes the stricter notification rules but questions vague concepts such as acting in concert and strategy, the scope of AFM supervision, and enforceability of identification against foreign parties.
The SP members regard the introduction of an additional notification threshold at 3% as an improvement.
De leden van de SP-fractie beschouwen de introductie van een additionele meldingsdrempel bij 3% als een verbetering.
Asks for justification of the tightened intention-notification rule, clarity on fines and warnings, the privacy implications of identification, and a right of objection for shareholders.
The government is of the view that such a right of objection would undermine the effectiveness of the scheme.
De regering is van mening dat een dergelijk verzetrecht afbreuk doet aan de effectiviteit van de regeling.
Asks whether the bill's identification rules are proportionate and whether they hamper effective enforcement, including cost burdens on issuers and intermediaries.
Is it correct that this bill practically does not allow issuing institutions to identify positions per shareholder?
Klopt het dat onderhavig wetsvoorstel de uitgevende instellingen praktisch niet toestaat de posities per aandeelhouder te identificeren?
Argues that raising the agenda right threshold from 1% to 3% and adding a response time weakens shareholder checks and counterweights within the company.
Does the government share the view that this is not an improvement but a deterioration of the checks and balances within the company?
Deelt de regering de mening dat dit geen verbetering, maar een verslechtering is van de checks en balances binnen de vennootschap?
Asks for the government's position on empty voting and securities lending, and on the outcome of the consultation on enquiry rights.
Asks for a comparison of corporate governance provisions with other countries and for clarification on two points; raises administrative burden concerns.
These members thank the government for its answers to the questions asked, but still need clarification on two points.
Deze leden danken de regering voor de antwoorden op de gestelde vragen maar hebben ten aanzien van twee punten nog behoefte aan verduidelijking.
Asks for a notification obligation at 1% changes, for statutory anchoring of the code if compliance stays insufficient, and for works council agenda rights at shareholder meetings.
Does the government share the PvdA members' view that it is also important for shareholders to know what is happening among employees?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de PvdA-fractie dat het ook voor aandeelhouders van belang is kennis te nemen van wat speelt onder de werknemers
Asks whether changed economic circumstances affect the bill and how it relates to the Commissie-De Wit report and related proposals.
Can the government give a reasoned and detailed assessment of this currency?
Kan de regering over deze actualiteit een gemotiveerd en gedetailleerd oordeel geven?

Asks whether shareholders can notify non-support of strategy without consequences, whether the AFM will supervise intention notifications, and for an answer on possible market abuse and administrative burden estimates.
The SP members would like to hear from the government whether shareholders can indeed notify non-support of the strategy 'with impunity'.
Graag horen de leden van de SP-fractie van de regering of aandeelhouders inderdaad «ongestraft» kunnen melden de strategie niet te ondersteunen
Objects to suspending voting rights for three years when an intermediary does not cooperate with identification and asks whether a fine would be more proportionate.
The members have difficulty with the possibility that shareholders lose their voting rights for three years when an intermediary does not cooperate with identification.
De leden hebben moeite met de mogelijkheid dat aandeelhouders drie jaar hun stemrecht verliezen wanneer een tussenpersoon niet aan de identificatie meewerkt.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill (lowering the substantial-holding threshold to 3%, requiring shareholders to disclose objections to corporate strategy, and enabling shareholder identification) needs further consideration, citing unclear necessity, weak proportionality for privacy, a disproportionate sanction on dividend rights, and a missing advisory request to the Commissie vennootschapsrecht. The government's reply largely accepted the remarks: it dropped the dividend-suspension sanction, removed the dual enforcement track, changed the identification term to 'investeerder', and added safeguards, though it did not adopt the opt-out or the separate advisory request.
concerns: The Council questioned whether government has a responsibility to regulate shareholder objections to strategy and identification of small shareholders; the government justified intervention by the limited effectiveness of private initiatives.

Identification of small investors interferes with privacy and must be proportionate; the Council asked for consideration of an opt-out, which the government declined, though it replaced individual holdings disclosure with aggregate totals.
Suspension of dividend rights as a sanction hits the shareholder rather than the intermediary that failed to comply, which is disproportionate; the government removed this sanction.
Dual enforcement via civil and criminal law was questioned; the government dropped the criminal route and kept civil enforcement only.
The bill should be submitted to the Commissie vennootschapsrecht for advice; the government declined, arguing the effectiveness focus made it unnecessary.
Several redactional comments on cross-references in the draft were adopted.

32032.s: The bill simplifies the rules on sector subjects in the vmbo learning pathways by fixing one mandatory sector subject per sector and a common list of elective subjects for all students. It also sets transitional rules so the new provisions first apply to third-year students, with a separate ministerial regulation for intersectoral programmes.
32032.j: The memorandum justifies leaving intersectoral programme rules to a general administrative order because such programmes vary and students combine parts of different sectors.
q: For an intersectoral programme, the mandatory subject of the sector part is determined by or pursuant to a general administrative order.
Voor een intersectoraal programma wordt bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur bepaald welk verplicht vak het sectordeel omvat.
d: Artikel I, B, onderdeel 2 (art. 10b lid 6a WVO)

parties: Asks whether the bill truly achieves better progression and whether students receive enough guidance and preparation for future occupations.
These members ask whether this legislative amendment sufficiently meets its goal.
Deze leden vragen of deze wetswijziging wel voldoende beantwoordt aan het doel.
Criticises that subject associations such as the NVON and chemistry bodies were not consulted and asks why the government did not involve relevant stakeholders.
These members ask whether the government does not think these organisations are relevant for the broadest possible support.
Deze leden vragen of de regering niet van mening is dat deze organisaties relevant zijn voor een zo groot mogelijk draagvlak.
Welcomes the bill in principle but questions its usefulness for small schools with limited offerings and possible timetable problems.
These members ask whether this legislative amendment is meaningful for schools with a smaller offering.
Deze leden vragen of deze wetswijziging zinvol is voor scholen met een kleiner aanbod.
Asks whether more than one sector subject should be mandatory for some sectors and responds to a KNCV proposal to offer a choice for the second mandatory subject.
These members ask whether the government has considered setting more than one sector subject as mandatory for certain sectors.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of de regering heeft overwogen voor bepaalde sectoren toch meer dan één sectorvak vast te stellen.

32131.s: The bill unifies the wage concept used for social insurance premiums and income-dependent health contributions by aligning definitions across the Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen, Zorgverzekeringswet and Wet op de loonbelasting 1964. It replaces the employer reimbursement with an income-dependent contribution regime and makes many consequential amendments across social security and benefit laws.
32131.j: The memorandum justifies the regulatory delegations mainly by the need for technical detail and the fact that statutory references to lower regulation are needed for many provisions.
q: These exceptions are included in the Regulation on health insurance under a delegation provision. The reason is that several provisions require a reference to lower regulation.
Deze uitzonderingen worden krachtens een delegatiebepaling opgenomen in de Regeling zorgverzekering. De reden daarvoor is dat bij diverse bepalingen een verwijzing naar lagere regelgeving nodig is.
d: minimum and maximum wage amounts for income-dependent contribution
contribution percentages, including deviating rates for certain wage components
SVB rules on payment terms and manner of contribution to health insurance fund
rules for advance payment on refund decision
p: Wage definition is aligned with the Wet op de loonbelasting 1964 by reference, shifting its content to tax law.
Minister sets wage thresholds and amounts by regulation, with no explicit statutory limits on the amounts.(Consultation with other ministers only.)
Minister may set contribution percentages and deviating rates for specified wage components by regulation without statutory percentage limits.
SVB sets payment rules for contribution to the health insurance fund, subject to ministerial approval.

parties: Asks about levensloop treatment, the effect on benefit entitlements and employer exposure, and the auto-related incentive to inflate mileage before dismissal.
That now seems set to change.
Dat lijkt nu dus te gaan veranderen.
Asks about effects on low incomes and employment at the bottom of the labour market, and the possible link to restructuring of social security and social partner responsibility.
The bill must under no circumstances anticipate possible structural changes in social security.
Het wetsvoorstel mag onder geen beding vooruitlopen op mogelijke structuurveranderingen in de sociale zekerheid.
Asks whether the implementation date by royal decree is appropriate and why a pre-consultation procedure is not used, since the bezwaren could warrant further parliamentary attention.
Why then is a pre-consultation procedure not chosen?
Waarom wordt er dan ook niet gekozen voor een voorhangprocedure?

Asks for detailed distributional and income-effect figures, a cumulative account of compensation and a check on whether the supplementary package will be submitted to the Kamer via a nota van wijziging.
It is indicated that the supplementary package may still be adjusted to the latest insights prior to the entry into force of the uniform wage definition.
Er wordt aangegeven dat het aanvullende pakket nog kan worden bijgesteld naar de laatste inzichten voorafgaand aan de inwerkingtreding van het uniforme loonbegrip.
Worries that rising labour costs for low-wage and part-time jobs will harm their labour market position and asks on what developments implementation will be decided.
These members fear that because this labour becomes more expensive, the labour market position of part-time workers and workers on minimum wage will deteriorate.
Deze leden vrezen dat door het duurder worden van deze arbeid hierdoor de arbeidsmarktpositie van parttime werknemers en werknemers met een loon op minimumniveau verslechterd.
Supports reducing administrative burdens but calls for careful weighing of the effects of a uniform wage definition and asks whether abolishing the employee Awf premium forecloses future options.
However, according to these members, a careful weighing must take place between the advantages of a uniform wage definition and the effects this brings.
Wel dient er volgens deze leden een zorgvuldige afweging plaats te vinden tussen de voordelen van een uniform loonbegrip en de effecten die dit met zich meebrengt.
Supports the bill as a step toward simpler tax rules and asks for the car private-use options to be costed, without raising checks on the executive.
The members of the PVV group have taken note of this bill with approval.
De leden van de fractie van de PVV hebben met instemming van dit wetsvoorstel kennisgenomen.
Welcomes the simplification but asks the government to confirm the fundamental financing debate and to inform the Chamber of later changes and timelines.
When will the Chamber receive these adjustments, the members wonder?
Wanneer ontvangt de Kamer deze aanpassingen, zo vragen genoemde leden zich af?
Objects to setting the employee Awf premium to zero without a principled debate on who finances unemployment insurance, and questions the shift of influence between social partners and government.
This principled debate must be held and not made invisible implicitly through a simplification act.
Deze principiële discussie moet gevoerd worden en niet impliciet via een vereenvoudigingswet onzichtbaar worden gemaakt.
Worries about the Awf fund balance and the employment effects of higher wage costs for low incomes, and asks that the decision await the final evaluation of the small jobs scheme.

In conclusion, the GroenLinks members would like to wait with decision-making on this act until the final evaluation of the small jobs scheme pilot and would like to see the employment effects of rising wage costs.

Concluderend zouden de leden van de fractie van GroenLinks graag wachten met besluitvorming over deze wet tot de eindevaluatie pilot Kleine Banenregeling en zouden zij graag de werkgelegenheidseffecten zien als gevolg van de stijgende loonkosten.
Supports uniformity of the wage concept but worries about implementation burdens on the Belastingdienst, UWV and businesses given past problems.
They are concerned, however, whether rapid introduction of the act will not lead to an enormous burden for the Tax Authority, the UWV and entrepreneurs.
Zij zijn er wel bezorgd over of snelle invoering van de wet niet tot een enorme last zal leiden voor de Belastingdienst, de UWV en ondernemers.
Asks for updated income effect tables and justification for not compensating outliers, seeking more transparency for the Chamber.
The SP members would like an update on the income effects because since this bill was submitted, various things in the law and regulations have changed.
De leden van de fractie van de SP willen graag een update hebben van de inkomenseffecten omdat sinds het indienen van deze wet het een en ander in de wet en regelgeving veranderd is.

32221.s: The bill amends several laws governing the pay and pensions of ministers, state secretaries, MEPs, provincial, municipal and water board officials so that their allowances and pension claims are paid only in person and cannot be assigned to third parties. It ties the change to a prohibition on assigning these claims, with the explanatory memorandum noting that a two-thirds majority under Article 63 of the Constitution applies for members of parliament and that the Council of State advised on independence and cession rules.
32221.j: The memorandum justifies the non-assignability rule as safeguarding the independence of politically appointed officials and elected representatives, and notes the Council of State's advice on the need for a convincing motivation.
q: For all political office holders, it must be ensured that independence is guaranteed.
Voor alle politieke ambtsdragers geldt dat de onafhankelijkheid gewaarborgd dient te zijn.

parties: Asks whether the government does not execute cessie agreements for all political office-holders and whether other bodies such as councils pay allowances and cooperate in such agreements.
Does it also hold for all other political office-holders that the government does not execute cessie agreements?
Geldt ook voor alle andere politieke ambtsdragers dat de overheid geen cessieovereenkomsten uitvoert?
Stresses the importance of the independence of elected representatives and asks whether it is adequately protected apart from direct payment.
Can the government address whether this independence, apart from direct payment, is in its view sufficiently protected?
Kan de regering ingaan op de vraag of deze onafhankelijkheid, los van de directe betaling, naar haar mening voldoende beschermd is?
Expresses disappointment with the bill and refers to its earlier contribution on the companion bill.
The SP members also took note of this bill with disappointment.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben ook van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel met teleurstelling kennisgenomen.
Supports non-transferability and payment only in person to safeguard independence and asks whether the ban also covers members of executive boards and district councils.
They support the government's proposal that severance payments, allowances and transition payments for these officials be legally made non-transferable and paid only in person.

Zij steunen het voorstel van de regering dat wettelijk wordt geregeld dat schadeloosstellingen, vergoedingen en wachtgelden voor de hier bedoelde functionarissen niet overdraagbaar zijn en uitsluitend «in persoon» worden uitbetaald.
Takes interest in the bill and refers to its contribution on the companion bill.
The ChristenUnie members have taken note of this bill with interest.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.
Takes interest in the bill and refers to its contribution on the companion bill.
The SGP members have taken note of this bill with interest.
De leden van de SGP-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the government justify more fully why a cessation ban for politically-exposed officeholders' allowances is needed, and narrow its scope and entry-into-force provisions. The minister's reply rejects narrowing the ban to party-linked entities and shortens the commencement advice by extending the transition period to six months instead of a Royal Decree timing mechanism.
concerns: The Raad questioned whether a statutory ban is necessary to protect officeholders' independence, since goed overleg could achieve the goal without legislation; the government defends the statutory route for uniformity and independence.
The Raad advised limiting the cessation ban to assignments to political parties and affiliated bodies, whereas the government keeps the ban broad.
The Raad suggested commencement by Royal Decree tied to the first sitting day after the next elections; the government rejected this but lengthened the transition period to six months.
The Raad asked the explanatory memorandum to address the relation between the Statute's nullity rule for MEPs' allowances and the proposed ban; the government explained the difference.

32302.s: The bill amends the Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte so that the rent commission must rely on an existing energy performance certificate when assessing energy performance, and removes the rent-reduction fee in certain cases. It also creates a statutory basis for an AMvB to differentiate rental housing valuation by contract date until 1 January 2012.
32302.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB basis for differentiated valuation as needed for a transitional period and the energy certificate reliance as a practical rule for the commission.
q: Because this differentiated valuation is possible until 1 January 2012, the proposed article 10a lapses as of that date.
Omdat deze verschillende waardering mogelijk is tot 1 januari 2012 vervalt het voorgestelde artikel 10a met ingang van die datum.
d: valuation distinction by contract date until 2012
energy performance rules under Woningwet art. 120
p: Allows the AMvB to differentiate tenant protection and rent rules by contract date, with a sunset at 1 January 2012.
Removes the fee obligation for a party losing solely on the commission's own energy assessment, shifting cost risk toward tenants or landlords depending on the case.

parties: Asks whether existing Woningwet reasonableness-test powers already suffice, making the WWS change unnecessary, and whether it conflicts with the test.
The CDA members also wonder whether existing legislation does not offer sufficient possibilities to enforce measures.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen zich overigens af of bestaande wetgeving niet voldoende mogelijkheden biedt voor het afdwingen van maatregelen.
Supports the bill as balanced for tenants and landlords and asks about specific unreasonable outcomes under the new WWS.
Therefore the PvdA members support the bill amending the housing valuation system (WWS), so that it becomes attractive for landlords to invest in energy saving.

Daarom steunen de leden van de PvdA-fractie het wetsvoorstel dat wijziging van het woningwaarderingsstelsel (hierna: WWS) mogelijk maakt, zodat het voor verhuurders aantrekkelijk is om te investeren in energiebesparing.
Questions the energy label as metric, the liberalisation effects, the lack of accompanying subordinate regulation, and the missing calculation method for reasonable investments.
The SP members were surprised that the bill is not accompanied by pending underlying regulations.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben zich verbaasd over het feit dat het wetsvoorstel niet is voorzien van aanhangige onderliggende regelgeving.
Asks to see the AMvB content and whether it will be submitted to parliament, and questions the reliability of the energy label before legislating on it.
Does the government agree with the VVD members that the functioning and reliability of the renewed energy performance certificate must be beyond doubt before a bill is based on it?

Is de regering het met de leden van de VVD-fractie eens dat eerst de werking en betrouwbaarheid van het vernieuwde energieprestatiecertificaat boven alle twijfel moet zijn verheven alvorens er een wetsvoorstel op te baseren?
Asks about rent differences from the transitional period and whether tenants must go twice through the Huurcommissie procedure.
Does this mean it is possible that a tenant in this case has to follow a procedure with the Huurcommissie twice?
Betekent dit dat het mogelijk is dat een huurder in dit geval twee keer een procedure bij de huurcommissie moet volgen?
Asks how retroactive rent reductions for existing leases can be justified given criteria not binding when contracts were signed.
These members ask how the government justifies that from 1 January 2012 rent reductions become possible for ongoing leases based on criteria that were not binding when the lease was concluded.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen hoe de regering rechtvaardigt dat vanaf 1 januari 2012 de mogelijkheid ontstaat van huurprijsverlaging bij lopende huurovereenkomsten op grond van criteria die geen verplichtend karakter hadden op het moment van sluiten van de huurovereenkomst.

32311.s: The bill amends the Working Hours Act to implement Article 19(2) of EU Regulation 561/2006 on road transport driving and rest times, so that infringements found in the Netherlands against non-resident drivers or foreign employers are sanctioned there. It extends extraterritorial application of Dutch administrative and criminal rules, with a ne bis in idem safeguard where a sanction already exists.
32311.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by the need for effective enforcement in the interest of road safety, since reporting infringements to the country of establishment has proved ineffective.
q: The rationale of this provision is that reporting infringements to the country of establishment has in practice proved insufficiently effective.
Ratio van deze bepaling is dat rapportage van overtredingen aan het land van vestiging in de praktijk te weinig effectief is gebleken.
p: Extends Dutch administrative sanctioning and criminal jurisdiction to conduct abroad by non-resident drivers and foreign employers in road transport, limited to specified economic offences and to transport covered by the EU regulation or AETR.

parties: Asks how far the bill merely implements the letter of the regulation and how other member states implement it.
These members ask to what extent the government, with this bill, merely strictly implements the letter of the regulation.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre de regering met dit wetsvoorstel slechts strikt uitvoering geeft aan de letter van de verordening.
Questions why the Netherlands has not implemented article 19(2) on time and whether the Netherlands risks infringement proceedings before the European Court of Justice.
The Netherlands therefore does not yet comply with this European provision.
Nederland voldoet daarom nog niet aan deze Europese bepaling.
Argues the bill reverses the burden of proof onto individual drivers, weakens their legal position, and raises ne bis in idem concerns and obstacles to appeal.
The SP members believe this amounts to a reversal of the burden of proof, resulting in an undesirable erosion of the legal position of the professional driver.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat hierdoor sprake is van een omkering van de bewijslast, met als gevolg een ongewenste verschraling van de rechtspositie van de beroepschauffeur.
Opposes the bill, considers the 28-day check period too long, and asks for justification of why reporting to the home state was ineffective and about arbitrariness and divergent fines abroad.
They are of the view that the 28-day control period applied is unnecessarily long.
Zij zijn van mening dat de gehanteerde controletermijn van 28 dagen onnodig lang is.
Asks how overlapping procedures in several states are handled to prevent double sanctioning and how long drivers must keep proof of sanctions.
These members ask how long the retention period is that applies to this.
Deze leden vragen hoe lang de bewaartermijn is, die hiervoor geldt.

32395-G.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the BTW-compensatiefonds, reducing expenditure by 21,500 thousand euros in line with the Voorjaarsnota. It also sets that the amended figures are stated in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 June 2010 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het BTW-compensatiefonds voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

32401.s: The bill amends several Dutch tax laws (income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, inheritance tax, VAT, excise, customs and others) with mostly technical corrections, cross-reference updates and some substantive changes such as extending the environmental investment allowance to all electric cars and a 50/50 attribution of jointly owned assets. Several provisions delegate detailed rule-making to ministerial regulations and general administrative orders, partly responding to a motion asking the government to stop delegating deviations from statute.
32401.j: The memorandum justifies delegations as technical aids for practical simplification of wage tax and implementing rules, and says the motion against delegated deviation from statute has been partly implemented.
q: The proposal aims to include a number of targeted delegation provisions to set additional rules by general administrative order for certain groups, to avoid practical difficulties.

Het voorstel richt zich op het opnemen van een aantal gerichte delegatiebepalingen om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur, ter vermijding van praktische moeilijkheden, aanvullende regels te stellen voor bepaalde groepen.
d: Artikel III, E (art. 27 Wet LB 1964, zesde lid)
alternative wage tax timing and table for working children
wage tax rules for benefit recipients, subcontractors and home workers
Artikel III, K en L (art. 35, 35g Wet LB 1964)
rules on consumptions and meals for artists and athletes
applicability of amended implementing provisions to opting employers
Artikel I, P, Q, R (art. 5.14, 5.15, 5.18a Wet IB 2001, zevende lid)
rules on indirect credit provision by funds
conditions for exemption on gifts for owner-occupied housing
conditions under which deferral of tax payment may be continued
Artikel XIV, A (art. 4o Wet internationale bijstandsverlening)
p: Artikel I, E (art. 3.92 Wet IB 2001, vierde lid)
Attributes assets in community of property equally to both spouses, limiting tax planning discretion of taxpayers rather than executive power.
Artikel III, B en C (art. 13, 18h Wet LB 1964)
Removes a statutory exception and a sentence, reducing legal text that could be read as deviating from the statute.
Removes a provision of the earlier bill that had been criticised as allowing deviation from statute by lower regulation.

parties: Asks the government to justify definitions, budgetary effects and complexity of several tax measures, including the tbs-regime and transfer tax changes.
These members ask the government to justify why it chose a definition based on range rather than environmental performance.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering te onderbouwen waarom gekozen is voor een definitie op basis van actieradius in plaats van op milieuperformance.
Asks about budget exhaustion, the Code Banken condition for cultural funds, and the NOB's criticism of the bill.
These members also ask the government to respond to the NOB's comments on this bill.
Tevens verzoeken deze leden de regering om te reageren op het commentaar op het onderhavige wetsvoorstel van de NOB.
Asks the government to respond point by point to the NOB's ten objections and to an academic alternative on the tbs-regime, and to justify budgetary losses.
The CDA members ask the government to respond to these ten points, one by one.
De leden van de CDA-fractie verzoeken de regering op deze tien punten – per punt – te reageren.
Questions the choice of the 50 km threshold, the absence of CO2 criteria, budget for the enlarged gift exemption, and progress on the private asset fund (afgezonderd particulier vermogen) monitoring.
What is the underlying reason that CO2 emissions are not considered?
Wat is de achterliggende reden dat er niet wordt gekeken naar de uitstoot van CO 2 ?
Asks about the scope of the green car allowance and the rules on carry-over of substantial-interest claims for surviving spouses.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Fiscale verzamelwet 2010, asking for more justification on excluding non-resident taxpayers from certain personal deductions (durfkapitaal losses and charitable gifts) and for a transitional rule on the renamed erfbelasting/schenkbelasting. The government's nader rapport defends the existing approach on the deductions, drops the transitional rule and clarifies the explanatory memorandum, and adopts the Raad's drafting remarks.
concerns: The Raad doubts compatibility with EU free movement of capital for excluding non-residents from deductions for durfkapitaal losses and gifts and asks for a justification in the memorie van toelichting, which the government addresses only partly by adding explanation in the reply rather than the memorie.

The Raad asks the explanatory memorandum to justify why no transitional rule was provided for renamed taxes, and the government drops the Belastingplan 2010 transitional rule and clarifies the memorie.
The Raad gives several redactional remarks in an annex, which the government adopts.

32500-IIA.s: This bill fixes the 2011 budget statement of the States General (Eerste and Tweede Kamer), setting expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros and specifying entry into force on 1 January 2011. It contains no delegation of rule-making powers to the executive and no provisions shifting power away from the checks.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2011 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32609-XVIII.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statements of the Ministry of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration (Wonen, Wijken en Integratie) and its baten-lastendiensten, as part of a departmental reorganisation. It moves the budgets to the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and, for 2011, waives the annual report and closing balance normally required under the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
32609-XVIII.j: The memorandum justifies waiving the annual report and closing balance by noting that no financial year accounts are produced for 2011 because the budget is transferred to the Ministry of the Interior.
q: For the year 2011, therefore, no accountability takes place on the basis of financial annual documents of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration.
Over het jaar 2011 vindt er dus geen verantwoording plaats aan de hand van financiële jaarstukken van Wonen, Wijken en Integratie.
p: For 2011 the minister responsible for the budget is the Minister of the Interior, and no annual report or closing balance is required, reducing accountability documentation to parliament; the RAD and Algemene Rekenkamer can still check the transfer in their 2011 audit.

32780-I.s: This bill amends the expenditure statement of the Budget of the King (I) for the year 2011, increasing the functional expenditure of the King by 328 thousand euros and other budget lines by 63 thousand euros. It takes effect from 1 June 2011, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The expenditure statement belonging to the budget of the King (I) for the year 2011 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingstaat behorende bij de begroting van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33004.s: This omnibus tax bill for 2012 amends several tax laws (income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, inheritance tax, turnover tax, car taxes, excise, general tax act, Caribbean Netherlands tax law) with technical repairs and policy changes. It also introduces new rule-making powers, a higher penalty regime, and an appeal route in tax cases for the BES islands.
33004.j: The memorandum justifies delegations on the grounds that rules are technical, need quick adjustment as EU rules change, and must follow practice; it grounds the new taxpayer reporting duty in fraud reduction and administrative efficiency.
q: For that reason it is proposed not to keep the quarterly listing threshold in the Turnover Tax Act 1968, but instead to set this threshold by ministerial regulation.

Om die reden wordt voorgesteld de grens voor de kwartaallisting niet langer in de Wet op de omzetbelasting 1968 (Wet OB 1968) op te nemen, maar in plaats daarvan de deze grens bij ministeriële regeling vast te stellen.
d: further conditions for rental agreements between co-residing parents
designation of mobility projects eligible for tax-free benefits
designation of paramedics and conditions for their declarations
data to be supplied in annual wage statements and their form
conditions for service contracts with approved training companies
exclusion of bodies or activities from volunteer cost deduction
designation of EEA states for insurance tax rules
conditions and restrictions for periodic car tax payment permits
rules for tax credit on converted vehicles
conditions for tax offset on foreign-registered leased vehicles
cases where taxpayers must proactively report errors and time limits
threshold for mandatory court custody of seized goods
payment and benefit rules for allowances
p: Allows the executive to oblige taxpayers to proactively report errors, backed by administrative fines up to 100 percent of unpaid tax.
Permits imposing a penalty for an offence after an earlier late-filing penalty for the same act when new objections come to light.
Benefit payments go only to a designated personal bank account, removing direct payment to third parties such as landlords and insurers.
Allows tax collectors to stop vehicles and enforce payment at any hour, with enforcement authorized by a data-sharing mechanism rather than a court order.
Introduces single-judge handling and simplified judgments for tax appeals on the BES islands, with a right of objection.
Opens appeal to the Court of Justice for tax cases on the BES islands, strengthening citizen legal protection.

parties: Asks whether the executor's joint liability for inheritance tax creates disproportionate risk and whether the sector can limit it privately.
Regarding the executor's joint liability for inheritance tax, the state secretary sees a disproportionate risk for the executor.
Ten aanzien van de hoofdelijke aansprakelijkheid van de executeur voor de verschuldigde erfbelasting, ziet de staatssecretaris een buitenproportioneel risico voor de executeur
Asks whether benefit recipients acting in good faith but late in supplying data are protected from fines, and whether corporations' payments can be safeguarded.
Agrees with most measures and proposes removing the sub-tenancy escape from the cohabiting-family partner criterion.
The PVV members therefore propose to remove the sub-tenancy escape.
De leden van de fractie van de PVV stellen dan ook voor om de escape van de onderhuur te schrappen.
Objects that the single bank account rule can disrupt direct payments to childcare providers and housing corporations, and that new penalty powers lack transitional law and legal certainty.
The major objection the CDA members have to this measure is that it will no longer be possible to pay childcare allowance directly to the childcare provider.
Het grote bezwaar dat de leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met deze maatregel is dat het ook niet meer mogelijk wordt om de kinderopvangtoeslag direct over te laten maken
Asks whether the fiction for missing income data creates fraud risk and whether income is being reconstructed in cases that do not reflect actual income.
Is there a chance citizens receive more money than they are entitled to when they do not supply income data?
Bestaat er een kans dat burgers meer geld krijgen dan waar ze recht op hebben wanneer ze geen inkomensgegevens aanleveren
Questions whether the new fine after a late-penalty conflicts with the ne bis in idem principle and the Sopropé ruling requiring a hearing before fiscal fines.
Experts indicate that this proposal conflicts with the ne bis in idem principle.
Door deskundigen wordt aangegeven dat dit voorstel in strijd is met het ne-bis-in-idem beginsel.

33013.s: This bill amends the Pension Act and the Mandatory Occupational Pension Act to change terminology from reinsurance to insurance, extend partner pension rules on risk basis when changing jobs, and ban capital contracts for insured pension funds with a transition deadline of 1 January 2017. It also makes consequential changes to the Notarial Profession Act.
33013.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by reference to European Commission arguments and the Directive 2003/41/EC minimum capital requirement, not by new executive powers.
q: Through this amendment of the Pensions Act (and the Mandatory Occupational Pension Scheme Act) the terminology is adjusted accordingly.
Door middel van onderhavige wijziging van de Pensioenwet (en de Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling) wordt de terminologie dienovereenkomstig aangepast.

parties: Asks how partner pension choices work, the size of the group affected by standard conversion, and implications for ex-partners in divorce, without raising checks on the executive.
The VVD members ask the government to explain to what extent participants can themselves choose between a risk-based and an accrual-based partner pension.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering om toe te lichten in hoeverre deelnemers zelf kunnen kiezen voor een partnerpensioen op risicobasis of op opbouwbasis.
Asks about the scale of insufficient coverage in partner pensions, whether social partners will act, and the number of capital contracts to be phased out.
The PVV members ask whether the government can explain in how many cases partner pension coverage on a risk basis is insufficient and to what extent job mobility is thereby hindered.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of de regering kan toelichten in hoeveel gevallen sprake is van ontoereikende dekking bij partnerpensioen op risicobasis en in welke mate de baanmobiliteit hierdoor wordt belemmerd.

Questions why the government did not make the option of conversion mandatory or standardise survivor pensions, and asks for transparency of asset management costs and the risks of capital contracts, relying on DNB and Star advice.
If the government does not choose standard conversion, why does it not at least make it mandatory that the option to convert is offered?
Indien de regering niet voor standaarduitruil kiest, waarom stelt de regering dan in ieder geval niet verplicht dat de mogelijkheid tot uitruil wordt geboden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Verzamelwet SZW 2012, a omnibus bill mixing technical and substantive changes across social security, employment, pensions and childcare, and objected that it did not meet the criteria for omnibus legislation, asking for better motivation or adaptation. The minister's reply reports that the bill was split into three separate bills (pensions, childcare, and remaining SZW changes) and that the redactional remarks were adopted.
concerns: The omnibus bill mixes technical and substantive changes without sufficient mutual coherence, so it does not meet the criteria for omnibus legislation, and the explanatory memorandum should justify why separate laws were not used.
Redactional remarks on the draft, including clarifying the Kinderbijslagwet beschikking and aligning the Besluit uitvoering Pensioenwet with the amended article 61, were adopted.

33022.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2010/24/EU on mutual assistance in recovering tax and similar claims, setting out how the Netherlands must provide and may request information, service of documents, recovery and conservatory measures across member states. It designates the Minister of Finance as competent authority and central liaison office, and withdraws the earlier mutual assistance act.
33022.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the difficulty of recovering taxes across borders, mobility of persons and capital, and rising fraud, and says the Directive requires these arrangements.
q: It is often difficult for the administrative authorities of a member state to recover taxes outside their own territory.
Het is vaak lastig voor de administratieve autoriteiten van een lidstaat om buiten het eigen grondgebied belastingen in te vorderen.
d: designation of competent authority and liaison bodies
p: The Minister may order administrative investigations to obtain information requested by another member state, applying Dutch collection procedures by analogy.
The Minister may refuse to provide information on listed grounds, including security and public order, and must inform the requesting authority of the reasons.
Foreign claims are collected by a designated receiver applying Dutch collection law with several Invorderingswet safeguards removed by reference, subject to the general disputes rules of Article 29.
Conservatory measures on request from another state, with the Minister seeking court leave for attachment under Dutch procedures.
Information obtained may be used for other purposes or passed to third member states under specified conditions, with the Minister holding consent authority.
Disputes over the underlying claim are referred to the courts of the requesting state, while disputes over Dutch enforcement measures remain with Dutch courts.

parties: Supports the bill as a matter of everyone meeting tax obligations, asking for explanation of low recovery rates, outstanding amounts, costs and whether the bill goes beyond the directive.
These members believe everyone must meet their (tax) obligations and therefore view this bill positively.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat iedereen aan zijn of haar (belasting)verplichtingen moet voldoen en staat daarom positief tegenover dit wetsvoorstel

Asks technical questions on whether including parking levies is desirable, the risk of bureaucracy from the absence of a threshold for information requests, and whether Dutch interests or citizens face risks of wrongful pursuit.
Is the government not afraid of enormous bureaucracy because parking levies will also fall under this bill?
Is de regering niet bang voor een enorme bureaucratie doordat de parkeerbelastingen ook onder dit wetsvoorstel gaan vallen?

Raises unequal treatment of foreign versus Dutch offenders under the EUR 1,500 threshold, whether wheel clamping and towing of foreign-plated cars is justified, and the government's treatment of EU residents not paying parking levies.
Is there not a case of unequal treatment, ask the members of the PVV group.
Is er hier geen sprake van ongelijke behandeling, zo vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie.
Welcomes broader assistance possibilities as a fraud-fighting tool and asks for data on how often assistance requests succeed and who bears costs when recovery fails.
It must not be the case that fraudsters with tax debts in the Netherlands move their assets abroad, so that the Netherlands cannot recover the debt and is left with the damage.
Het mag niet zo zijn dat fraudeurs met belastingschulden in Nederland hun vermogen naar het buitenland verplaatsen, waardoor Nederland de schuld niet kan invorderen en met de schade blijft zitten.
Asks about the expected higher recovery percentage, which restrictive conditions of the old directive were dropped, the list of local levies covered, and capacity relief for the CLO.
Does the government expect that after this bill takes effect a higher percentage will actually be recovered?
Verwacht de regering dat er na inwerkingtreding van voorliggend wetsvoorstel een hoger percentage daadwerkelijk wordt ingevorderd?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory opinion supports the draft WWB 2012 implementing Directive 2010/24/EU on mutual assistance for recovery of tax claims, but raises numerous points on its relationship to the WIB and on the technical way the Directive is transposed, including omitted provisions and inconsistent structure. The government's reply largely accepts the advice, adopting most points and explaining the few it declines, such as not listing all covered taxes.
concerns: The Afdeling advises aligning the WWB 2012's systematics and wording as closely as possible with the Directive, and the government largely adopts this, revising several articles.

The Afdeling advises separating obligations for Dutch assistance given from assistance requested by the Netherlands, which the government addresses only partly by adding clarifying definitions while keeping chapter 1 unified.
The Afdeling asks for an explanation of the relationship between the WWB 2012 and the WIB, which the government addresses by adding a passage to the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling advises concretising which taxes and levies the law covers for the Netherlands, which the government declines as impractical to maintain.

33112.s: The bill expands police search powers in public spaces and police cells, including a new burgemeester power to designate a short-term weapons risk zone (up to twelve hours) in unforeseen emergencies, and allows officers to search persons being transported and to search persons inside police cells. It also lets the head of a police unit authorise body searches and medical examinations of detainees in limited circumstances.
33112.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by practical gaps in preventive searching during sudden incidents and by police requests to search detainees more effectively, comparable to the Penitentiary Principles Act.
q: That condition is lacking, however, when a concrete incident suddenly occurs outside an already designated area, so that the need to apply preventive searching on the spot is both unforeseeable and urgent.

Die tijd ontbreekt echter als zich plotseling een concreet incident voordoet buiten een al aangewezen gebied, dus als de noodzaak om ter plaatse het instrument preventief fouilleren toe te passen, zowel onvoorzienbaar als spoedeisend is.
d: authorising internal body examination of detainees
further rules on searches of persons and detainees
p: Allows the mayor to designate a weapons risk zone of up to twelve hours in unforeseen emergencies, with notice to the council afterwards and an officer of justice order required for the search.
Politiewet 201x art. 7, derde en vierde lid
Extends search powers to belongings carried by persons and creates a standard search power for persons transported by police, without requiring an objectively identifiable threat.
Politiewet 201x art. 7, vijfde en zesde lid
Allows body searches and internal examinations of detained persons on the authorisation of the head of a police unit, subject to conditions borrowed from prison law.

parties: Asks how the hulpofficier van justitie can order frisking given that the officier van justitie is always reachable, and wants concrete criteria for urgent exceptions.
When is there a situation so urgent that the arrival of the officier van justitie cannot be awaited?
Wanneer is er sprake van een situatie die dermate spoedeisend is dat de komst van de officier van justitie niet kan worden afgewacht?
Worries that shifting the frisking order to a hulpofficier removes independent assessment by the Openbaar Ministerie and asks about safeguards and ECtHR independence.
Once the hulpofficier van justitie takes over the decision, the independent assessment by the OM would be missing.
Op het moment dat de hulpofficier van justitie de beslissing overneemt zou de onafhankelijke beoordeling door het OM gemist worden.

Notes the Raad van State warning that the guarantee of officier van justitie review is eroded and asks for examples of urgent situations; also questions why burgemeesters should get standalone power without council consent.
The Council of State's advisory division believes the proposal erodes the safeguard of review by the officier van justitie as a member of the judiciary.
De Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State meent dat met het voorstel de waarborg die uitgaat van de toetsing door de officier van justitie als lid van de magistratuur wordt uitgehold.
Doubts the effectiveness and proportionality of frisking, asks for data on use and police capacity, and wants to know why councils that withheld the power should be bypassed.
What the SP members believe must never be lost sight of is whether the deployment of resources, such as costly police capacity, is proportionate to the aim.
Wat naar de mening van de leden van de SP-fractie nooit uit het oog mag worden verloren, is de vraag of de inzet van middelen, zoals kostbare politiecapaciteit, wel in verhouding staat tot het doel.
Objects that the expansion intrudes further on the rights of non-suspects, demands legitimacy criteria, prior justification, review of proportionality and an evaluation clause.
They believe it must be clear in advance for what purpose and on what criteria frisking takes place, and afterwards a review of proportionality and necessity must be possible.

Zij menen dat vooraf duidelijk moet zijn met welk doel en op grond van welke ecriteria wordt gefouilleerd en achteraf een toetsing moet kunnen plaatsvinden van de proportionaliteit en noodzakelijkheid van het middel.
Questions the hierarchical position of hulpofficiers under the burgemeester, the necessity of the illustrated examples, and the risk that preventive frisking is misused for investigation purposes.
These members ask what safeguards exist to ensure the frisking power is not misused for other purposes.
Deze leden vragen welke waarborgen er zijn dat de bevoegdheid tot fouilleren niet wordt misbruikt voor andere doeleinden.
Asks how many councils have granted burgemeesters the power, why oral rather than written orders are used, and whether the 12-hour limit can be extended.
Is no prior consent from the council necessary for the burgemeester's independent power?
Is er bij de eigenstandige bevoegdheid van de burgemeester geen enkele voorafgaande toestemming door de raad noodzakelijk?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill expanding preventive frisk powers (incidental frisk by mayor, oral orders, body searches of detainees), raising major objections on necessity, the hulpofficier's authority, oral orders, the stop-and-search order contents, and body searches in police cells. The government's reply followed several points (written orders, proportionality safeguards for incidental designation) but rejected the hulpofficier role, body-search authority at district level, and the body-search proposal's alignment with prison rules.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the necessity of expanding preventive frisk powers be motivated in the explanatory memorandum, which the government did not substantively address beyond describing practical needs.
Authorizing the hulpofficier van justitie to issue frisk orders weakens the prosecutor's safeguard, and the Afdeling advised reconsidering this; the government did not follow this advice.
The Afdeling advised that oral frisk orders be recorded in writing beforehand unless urgency prevents it, and the government followed this advice.
The Afdeling advised applying proportionality safeguards (maximum duration and area limits, revocation) to the incidental designation, and the government followed this advice.

The Afdeling advised reconsidering internal body searches of detainees in police cells as disproportionate, given the far more intrusive nature and the differing legal basis compared with prison regimes; the government did not follow this.
The Afdeling advised that body-search decisions be taken by a high judicial authority such as the officier van justitie rather than the district chief, and the government rejected this.
The Afdeling advised considering scanning technology as a less intrusive alternative to internal body searches; the government responded that police facilities lack such equipment.
A redactional correction to a paragraph reference in the explanatory memorandum was adopted.

33121.s: The bill introduces a bank tax (bankenbelasting) levied on banks with a seat in the Netherlands and on foreign banks operating through Dutch branches, computed on a balance-sheet base net of certain liabilities with a rate schedule and a efficiency exemption. The bill also sets indexation of the exemption amount by ministerial regulation every five years and allows the tax inspector to permit calculation in other currencies under ministerial rules.
33121.j: The memorandum explains that the indexation mechanism and currency rules are technical, with the currency rule intended to reduce administrative burden for international entities.
q: Article 12: The amounts stated in article 9 are changed every five years by ministerial regulation, effective 1 January of a year.
Artikel 12 De in artikel 9 vermelde bedragen worden elke vijf jaar met ingang van 1 januari van een jaar bij ministeriële regeling gewijzigd.
d: calculating taxable amount in non-euro currency

parties: Supports the bank tax as fair cost recovery while asking that it avoid stacking regulation and harm to the Dutch economy.
Although these members constantly strive to reduce the number of taxes, the VVD members consider it fair that the costs of these interventions be passed on to the banking sector through a bank tax.

Hoewel deze leden voortdurend streven naar het terugdringen van het aantal belastingen, achten de leden van de VVD-fractie het rechtvaardig dat de kosten van deze interventies middels een bankenbelasting worden doorberekend aan de bancaire sector.
Supports a bank tax but questions the one-year maturity cut-off, the exemption size, the BNG treatment and the earmarking of revenue, and asks for an EU-wide approach.
These members are in favour of levying a tax on banks, but still have additional comments and questions on the proposed measures.
Deze leden zijn voorstander van het heffen van een belasting op banken, maar hebben bij de voorgestelde maatregelen nog wel aanvullende opmerkingen en vragen.
Asks for justification of the exemption, its equality implications, cost-benefit of enforcement and the bonus surcharge design.
It seems to the PVV members that it is not worth the Tax Administration's effort to levy the bank tax on a large group of banking institutions because the yield falls below EUR 33,000.
Het lijkt de leden van de PVV-fractie of het de Belastingdienst niet de moeite loont om van een grote groep bankinstellingen de bankenbelasting te heffen omdat de opbrengst onder de € 33 000 komt.
Sets conditions that the tax must not reduce lending, must not be passed on to savers, and must avoid cumulation; asks for DNB-based credit estimates and clarity on double taxation.
For the CDA members, a number of conditions are important when introducing the tax.
Voor de leden van de CDA-fractie is een aantal voorwaarden bij de invoering van belang.
Welcomes the bank tax and asks why the government changed its position and about revenue splits and the earmarking for the property transfer tax cut.
The SP members are pleased that the Netherlands, following all surrounding countries, is finally also getting a bank tax.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn verheugd dat Nederland in navolging van alle omliggende landen nu eindelijk ook een bankenbelasting krijgt.
Questions moral hazard, whether the randvoorwaarden are met after implementation, the credit reduction estimate and whether a fiscal instrument suits the bonus rules.
These members question whether a fiscal penalty is the right way to make binding agreements on remuneration policy.
Deze leden zetten er hun vraagtekens bij of een fiscale boete de juiste weg is om dwingende afspraken te maken over beloningsbeleid.
Asks for fuller justification of the price-setting goal, the link to future intervention, the bonus measure's overlap and possible counter-effects, and the FTT relationship.
Although the ChristenUnie members endorse this goal, these members believe a more extensive justification is desirable.
Hoewel de leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie dit doel onderschrijven, menen deze leden dat een uitgebreidere onderbouwing gewenst is.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Dutch bank tax bill (Wet bankenbelasting), questioning its three objectives (sector contribution, risk management, curbing variable pay), the short/long-term debt tariff design, the link to the remuneration code, and the three preconditions (EU coordination, cumulation of measures, credit impact). The government's reply largely rejects the objections, defends the tariff and the level playing field with France and Germany, and agrees to adjust wording on branches and the definition of directors.
concerns: The Council doubts the bank tax's effectiveness for risk management and questions whether a fiscal measure is the best instrument, given that the short/long-term tariff distinction may penalise sound asset-liability management.

The Council considers the link of the tariff to the 100% bonus norm of the Banking Code improper and in tension with the comply-or-explain principle, and advises deleting it; the government defends the link and does not delete it.

The Council argues the justification for the bank tax (sector contribution for past state support) is insufficiently convincing, as the support went to only a few banks while the tax has a generic scope.

The Council finds that the three preconditions (EU coordination, avoiding cumulation of measures, credit impact) have not been sufficiently assessed, and that the level playing field is judged on revenue rather than on individual burdens.
The Council asks for clarity on the timing of entry into force and on the relation between the bank tax and the planned EU financial transaction tax.

The Council points out inconsistency between the bill's text (taxpayer is the entity) and the explanatory memorandum (branches), and asks clarification of the broader term 'bestuurder'; the government adjusts the memorandum.

33220.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the European Council decision of 25 March 2011 amending Article 136 TFEU to establish a stability mechanism for euro-area member states. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
33220.j: The memorandum argues the decision does not extend EU competences, is a confirmation of existing powers, and therefore needs only parliamentary approval under the Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen.
q: The third paragraph to be inserted in Article 136 does not in fact confer any powers on the EU.
Het in artikel 136 in te voegen derde lid verleent immers geen bevoegdheden aan de EU.

parties: Has no questions or remarks on the Council decision.
It saw no reason to ask questions or make remarks on it.
Zij heeft hierin geen aanleiding gezien tot stellen van vragen of het plaatsen van opmerkingen.
Supports the bill but questions the tension between Article 136 and the no-bail-out rule, the link with the ESM treaty, and conditionality, and prefers solutions within the EU legal order.
Together with the Council of State, the PvdA members note a tension between the amended Article 136 TFEU and the no-bail-out rule in Article 125 TFEU.
Met de Raad van State signaleren de leden van de PvdA-fractie een spanningsveld tussen het geamendeerde artikel 136 VWEU en de no-bail out regel vervat in artikel 125 VWEU.

Sympathetic to the Council of State's objection that the route bypasses the EU legal order, and asks about the no-bail-out clause, IMF involvement and the consequences of intergovernmental decision-making.
However, these members wonder to what extent the condition that no powers are conferred on the EU has been met.](Raad van State concerns noted.)
Deze leden vragen zich echter wel af in hoeverre voldaan is aan de voorwaarde dat er geen bevoegdheden worden verleend aan de EU.
Objects to the simplified revision procedure, questions whether the amendment is needed at all, and asks for definitions of 'indispensable' and 'emergency' to limit discretion.
The SP members object to the procedure followed to introduce the permanent emergency fund.
De leden van de SP-fractie maken bezwaar tegen de gevolgde procedure om het permanente noodfonds in te voeren.
Asks the government to explain differences between the ESM treaty text and Article 136(3) TFEU and to clarify the scope of stability threats.
These members wonder whether the government can explain the differences between the text of the ESM treaty and the wording of Article 136(3) TFEU.
Deze leden vragen zich af of de regering de verschillen tussen de tekst van het ESM-verdrag en de bewoordingen van artikel 136, derde lid, van het VWEU kan toelichten.
Asks whether deliberately acting outside the no-bail-out rule and the EU legal order creates legal risks, and whether court cases challenge the EFSF.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government to indicate whether, by doing so, the no-bail-out provision of Article 125 TFEU was deliberately breached.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie verzoeken de regering aan te geven of daarmee dan ook bewust in strijd is gehandeld met de «no-bail-out»-bepaling van artikel 125 van het VWEU?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill approving the European Council decision amending Article 136 TFEU for a eurozone stability mechanism, but asks the government to explain why the mechanism sits outside the EU legal order, to clarify its compatibility with the no-bail-out rule in Article 125 TFEU, and to address the differing entry-into-force dates. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that the explanatory memorandum was amended on each of these three points.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should explain why a permanent stabilisation mechanism was set up by treaty outside the EU's autonomous legal order and institutional framework; the government amended the background section accordingly.
The statement that the mechanism does not conflict with Article 125 TFEU (no-bail-out) needs further justification; the government added explanation under 'Doel en betekenis'.
The memorandum should address the difference between the ESM entry-into-force date (1 July 2012) and the amendment's date (1 January 2013); the government added this to the explanation.
