33400-IIA.s: This bill sets the 2013 budget of the Staten-Generaal (House of Representatives and Senate) in thousands of euros, with the annex listing spending and income for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and interparliamentary relations. The explanatory memorandum describes the budget lines and policy priorities of the two chambers without delegating rule-making power or shifting power from the parliament toward the executive.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2013 belonging to this act is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

33805-J.s: The bill amends the departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds for 2013, adjusting appropriations and receipts for its articles and adding a Marker Wadden experiment project with a EUR 15 million contribution from the Ministry of Economic Affairs. It also sets the effective date of the amendment to 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
33805-J.j: The memorandum justifies the budget amendment by the need to adjust the 2013 Deltafonds budget statement, with no delegation or new powers justified.

33940-J.s: The bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Delta Fund (first supplementary budget), reallocating spending commitments, expenditures and receipts across the fund's programmes, including a new 15 million euro experimentation programme under article III of the Delta Act. It also sets the budget statement's unit of account in thousands of euros and fixes its entry into force from 1 June 2014, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Delta Fund for the year 2014
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2014

34000-V.s: This bill formally establishes the 2015 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, setting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros for its policy and non-policy articles. It also sets the entry-into-force rule, under which the law takes effect on 1 January 2015 or retroactively from that date if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2015 attached to this law is hereby adopted.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34003.s: The bill modernises corporate income tax liability for government enterprises, making state and public-law bodies' commercial activities taxable while exempting activities linked to public tasks, intra-government activities and academic hospitals and universities. It also repeals the transitional exemption for certain seaport operators at a later date set by royal decree.
34003.j: The memorandum justifies the open 'overheidstaak' norm by saying a limitative list was deliberately not included, so practice must fill it in, and the repeal date is left to royal decree pending further developments.
q: In this bill it was deliberately chosen not to include an exhaustive list of government tasks / public-law powers.
Bij dit wetsvoorstel is er bewust voor gekozen geen limitatieve lijst met overheidstaken / publiekrechtelijke bevoegdheden op te nemen.
d: entry into force of repeal of seaport exemption (art. II)
further rules for applying the academic exemption
p: Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 8e Wet Vpb)
Activities linked to exercise of public tasks by public-law bodies are exempt from tax unless they compete with private enterprises, leaving the scope of 'public task' to be defined in practice.

parties: Supports a level playing field but asks whether the port exemption is aligned with the Commission and whether a feasibility test was done.
These members support the principle that government enterprises competing with private parties should also pay corporate income tax so that a level playing field arises.
Deze leden steunen het principe dat overheidsbedrijven die concurreren met private partijen ook vennootschapsbelasting gaan betalen zodat er een gelijk speelveld ontstaat.
Asks about EU state-aid procedure, the open norm on governmental tasks creating legal inequality, and high administrative burden.
On the other hand they fear the legal inequality, also mentioned by the government, that an open norm may cause.
Anderzijds vrezen zij voor de eveneens door de regering genoemde rechtsongelijkheid die een open norm tot gevolg kan hebben.
Questions the added value of taxing local governments, the open-norm approach, and the impact on local authorities and the Tax Administration.
These members wonder what the added value is of taxing local governments.
Deze leden vragen zich af wat de toegevoegde waarde is van het heffen op lokale overheden.
Welcomes tackling unfair competition but is concerned about administrative burden on municipalities and asks for clarity on open norms and exemptions.
However, these members are concerned about the administrative burden that this legislation will impose on municipalities and other governments.
Wel zijn deze leden beducht voor de administratieve lasten die als gevolg van deze wetgeving op gemeenten en andere overheden afkomt.
Asks for clearer guidance on excluded tasks and transitional rules for municipal land bureaus, and whether decentralised governments lose financially.
These members ask how the government views this and how it is ensured that decentralised governments do not lose financially due to this bill.
Deze leden vragen hoe de regering hier tegenaan kijkt en op welke wijze geborgd is dat decentrale overheden er niet financieel op achteruit gaan door dit wetsvoorstel.
Doubts the one-year implementation period, warns of legal uncertainty and administrative burden from open norms, and asks for a cost justification.
These members want to put a number of remarks and questions about the bill to the government.
Deze leden willen de regering enkele opmerkingen en vragen over het wetsvoorstel voorleggen.
Asks why the competition criterion was not central and says open norms such as undertaking and public task give the Tax Administration much discretion.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion (4 September 2014) supports the goal of the bill modernising corporate tax liability for government enterprises but raises major EU state-aid concerns, lack of analysis of the Commission's remedial measures, doubts about the one-year implementation period, and vague open norms. The government's reply (12 September 2014) accepts several points, adds explanatory detail and adjusts the bill, but does not fully resolve the state-aid and Commission-consultation concerns.
concerns: The Afdeling says the bill lacks attention to EU law and state-aid aspects and may not comply with EU law; the government added a broader EU-aspects explanation but kept the national-law-based system.

The Afdeling says the one-year implementation period is doubtful and open norms need concretisation; the government acknowledges the short period, seeks parliamentary speed and added examples to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling notes the concurrence criterion is unclear and possibly insufficient; the government removed the 'in concurrentie treden' condition for public-law bodies and adjusted the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling flags an inconsistent exemption for internal activities that may be unnecessary; the government added explanation to the memorandum.
The Afdeling raises a transitional-law problem on request deadlines and a redactional remark; the government amended the bill and made technical changes.

34012.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code (article 333k) to set out how employee co-determination is regulated in cross-border mergers of capital companies, following a 2013 EU Court of Justice ruling against the Netherlands. It sets rules for special negotiating bodies, agreements, default reference provisions and when European rules apply to the acquiring company.
34012.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to comply with the EU Court of Justice ruling of 20 June 2013 (case C-635/11) and the cross-border merger directive.
q: The Court of Justice of the European Union ruled on 20 June 2013 that the Netherlands had failed to meet its obligations on employee co-determination in cross-border mergers of capital companies.

Het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie heeft op 20 juni 2013 geoordeeld dat Nederland zijn verplichtingen inzake werknemersmedezeggenschap bij grensoverschrijdende fusies van kapitaalvennootschappen niet is nagekomen
d: co-determination agreement between merging companies and negotiating group
general meeting may authorise statutory changes for co-determination

parties: Asks whether the state was held liable for the faulty implementation, the competitive and investment-climate effects of wider co-determination coverage, and the reasons for certain provisions.
Has the Dutch state actually been held liable for the faulty implementation?
Is de Nederlandse staat daadwerkelijk aansprakelijk gesteld voor de foutieve implementatie?
Asks about the risks of unnecessary application of EU rules, the foreseeability of the Court's ruling, the pre-litigation exchanges with the Commission, and the costs incurred by the Netherlands.
What costs has the Netherlands incurred because of this procedure?
Welke kosten heeft Nederland vanwege deze procedure gemaakt?

34021.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 606/2013 on mutual recognition of protection measures in civil matters in Dutch law, allowing certificates to be requested from courts or mayors and enabling protected persons to adapt foreign measures to Dutch addresses. It also gives the Hague district court power to attach coercive measures or grant authority to enforce protection orders in the Netherlands.
34021.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to mayors and hulpofficieren by pointing to the need for simplicity and speed in issuing certificates and the existing mandate structure of the Wet tijdelijk huisverbod.
q: No appeal is open against the revocation of a certificate or the refusal thereof.
Tegen de intrekking van een certificaat of weigering daarvan staat geen voorziening open.
d: mayor or hulpofficier issuing certificates for temporary house bans
p: Certificate revocation or refusal by the mayor or hulpofficier is not open to appeal, limiting review of administrative decisions.
Mayors and hulpofficieren gain authority to issue certificates for temporary house bans, with a three-day waiting rule before issuance absent a hearing.

parties: Asks how to prevent a protection measure certificate from remaining in effect longer than the originating court determined, and who monitors and withdraws certificates.

They still have some questions or remarks.
Hoe kan worden voorkomen dat de werking van een beschermingsmaatregel neergelegd in een certificaat langer zal doorwerken dan door de rechterlijke macht in de «moeder-lidstaat» is bepaald?
How can it be prevented that the effect of a protection measure laid down in a certificate continues longer than the judiciary in the 'home Member State' has determined?
Zij hebben nog enkele vragen dan wel opmerkingen.

Questions whether appeal against certificate issuance is impossible in all cases and objects that no appeal lies against withdrawal of a certificate given its serious consequences for the protected person.
These members find it going too far that no appeal is open against the withdrawal of a certificate, given the far-reaching consequences for the protected person.
Deze leden vinden het ver gaan dat geen hoger beroep open staat tegen het intrekken van een certificaat, gelet op de verregaande gevolgen voor de beschermde persoon.

Asks whether appeals in first instance or on appeal by the person posing the threat suspend enforcement of a protection measure imposed in another Member State and what risks follow for the protected person.
They ask why Denmark does not take part in adopting the regulation in question.
Zij vragen waarom Denemarken niet deelneemt aan de vaststelling van de betreffende verordening.
Notes the missing financial section and asks for justification of the regulation's purpose given limited cross-border cases, and for data on expected use.
The aforementioned members note that a financial section is missing from the explanatory memorandum.
Voornoemde leden constateren dat er een financiële paragraaf ontbreekt in de memorie van toelichting.

Asks whether authorities were designated to the Commission before parliament adopted the implementing act, why the bill was submitted late, and what the consequences are if the act enters into force after 11 January 2015.
The bill was submitted to the House of Representatives on 9 September 2014.
Het wetsvoorstel is op 9 september 2014 ingediend bij de Tweede Kamer.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supported the bill implementing EU Regulation 606/2013 on mutual recognition of civil protection measures but advised on mandatory legal representation and court fees for adapting a certificate. The government reply states that adaptation requests can be filed without a lawyer and that no court fee will be charged, and it adopts the drafting remarks.
concerns: Mandatory legal representation for requesting adaptation of a certificate was disproportionate for factual address changes; the bill now allows filing without a lawyer.
Unclear whether court fees apply to adapting a certificate; the government now exempts factual adaptation from court fees via the Regeling griffierechten.
Redactional remarks on the wording and explanatory notes of several articles were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.

34085-XVIII.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statements for the Ministry of Housing and Central Government Affairs and for its executive agencies (baten-lastenagentschappen), in thousands of euros, via a second supplementary budget. It contains only budget appropriations and final formalities, with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

34111.s: The bill amends the Health Act (Gezondheidswet) and the Youth Act (Jeugdwet) to create a statutory basis for the active public disclosure of supervisory and enforcement information by the health, food and youth inspectorates, including compliance categories and identities of violators. The disclosure categories and details are to be set by general administrative order (AMvB), with a two-week standstill period and suspension on interim relief requests.
34111.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB route by the need for flexibility in phased expansion of disclosure without requiring a statutory amendment each time, while keeping legality safeguards.
q: For that reason it was chosen not to designate the information to be disclosed at the level of the formal statute, but at the level of the general administrative order.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen de openbaar te maken informatie niet aan te wijzen op het niveau van de formele wet, maar op het niveau van de algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: designating information and regulations subject to active disclosure of supervision and enforcement
assigning disclosure tasks to other supervisors or organisations
obliging other supervisors to provide information for disclosure
rules on period of online availability and implementation of disclosure
excluding disclosure of supervision information in the Caribbean public bodies
II (Art. 9.7, eerste en tweede lid, Jeugdwet)
designating information for disclosure and assigning disclosure to other bodies in youth care
rules on online disclosure period and implementation in youth care
p: Choice of which supervisory information and regulations are disclosed is left to a general administrative order rather than the statute itself, though the statute states the purposes and categories.
Disclosure decisions are exempt from the right to submit a view (zienswijze) and only a two-week standstill with a possible interim relief request protects affected parties.
The supervisory body decides which information is stripped of confidential, personal or professional-secrecy data before publication.
Disclosure is withheld where it would conflict with the purpose of the statute, a limited safeguard.

parties: Asks about the added value, scope, sector differences, risk of a distorted picture from risk-based inspection, and whether publication affects consumer responsibility; asks for a general regime.
Can it be explained what the added value of this bill is compared to the current situation?
Kan worden toegelicht wat de toegevoegde waarde van dit wetsvoorstel is ten opzichte van de huidige situatie?
Asks who decides on publication, whether the NVWA can handle the volume, whether affected parties can respond, and about the effect on those affected.
Do these affected parties actually have the opportunity to give their response?
Hebben deze betrokkenen wel de mogelijkheid om hun reactie te geven?
Supports publication as a tool against misconduct but warns it must not replace supervision; asks for objective individual weighing to avoid arbitrariness and for companies to be able to respond.
The last thing these members want is to create the appearance of arbitrariness or favouritism.
Het laatste wat deze leden willen is de schijn wekken van willekeur of vriendjespolitiek.

Supports the aim but questions the absence of individual balancing, the EVRM Article 6 'criminal charge' analysis given naming and shaming, legal safeguards, and the risk of less transparency from unstructured data.
The CDA members ask the government to substantiate this further.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering om dit nader te onderbouwen.
Supports active publication of inspection data but asks for a general regime, clarity on presentation of data, and information on other inspectorates.
They are in favour of actively publishing inspection data and data on the implementation of regulations.
Zij tonen zich voorstander van het actief openbaar maken van controlegegevens en gegevens over de uitvoering van regelgeving.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill on active public disclosure of supervisory data and sanction decisions by the NVWA, IGZ and IJZ should be aligned with a general regime, should allow individual balancing for sanction disclosure under Article 8 ECHR, should differentiate the standstill period, should require publication of the target's reaction, and should clarify effectiveness of disclosure. The government's reply accepted several points (timing of the two-week period from notification, a clause allowing non-disclosure where it would harm the law's purpose, clarifications in the explanatory memorandum) but rejected the requirement of individual balancing for sanctions, the mandatory publication of the target's reaction, and a differentiated standstill period beyond existing flexibility.
concerns: Disclosure of sanction decisions without individual balancing may disproportionately affect companies and persons, and Article 8 ECHR requires a proportionality assessment; the government rejected statutory individual balancing.
Blanket binding disclosure leaves no room for case-specific weighing of reputational harm against transparency aims, which the Council considers necessary.
The standstill period exception is unclear as to whether a shorter or no standstill period applies; the government clarified this in the memorandum but did not add a differentiated statutory regime.
Publishing large volumes of data unordered online may not achieve the aims; the government agreed it is not useful but left presentation to later practice.
The two-week period should run from notification of the decision to the party, not from the date the decision was taken; the government adopted this change.
Publication of the target's reaction to supervisory data was recommended; the government rejected a mandatory obligation and will regulate it by general administrative order.
The Council suggested a general statutory regime for active disclosure in the General Administrative Law Act; the government will explore this but proceeds with the specific bill.

34200-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statements of the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the Governors' offices of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, as the final budget adjustment (slotwet). It adjusts expenditure, commitment and revenue figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Commitments of about EUR 1.3 million less were realised and expenditure about EUR 1.4 million less was made.
Er zijn voor circa € 1,3 mln. minder verplichtingen gerealiseerd en voor circa € 1,4 mln. minder uitgaven gedaan.

34210-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statement of the Dutch States General (parliament), adjusting appropriations across its policy articles in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date of the amendment as 1 June 2015, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2015.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2015.

34300-IIA.s: This bill adopts the 2016 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Staten-Generaal, setting appropriations and receipts for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer, parliamentary allowances and interparliamentary activities in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force rule and gives the Minister of Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties responsibility for the budget.
q: The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is responsible for managing the budget of the Staten-Generaal.
De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van de begroting van de Staten-Generaal.

34775-C.s: The bill fixes the 2018 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) at 2,187,740 thousand euros, with commitment amounts for the general grant, integration and decentralisation grants, and research. It sets the entry-into-force rule of 1 January 2018 and provides for retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2018 belonging to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

35011.s: The bill requires that the polling-station minutes and municipal vote tallies be published electronically online without signatures, in addition to the existing public inspection at town halls. It also adds an electronic publication duty for the central polling board and raises the threshold for certain seat-allocation entitlement from 25% to 50% of the quota.
35011.j: The memorandum justifies electronic publication as increasing transparency and verifiability of the election result and notes that privacy interests are weighed against the public interest in authenticity.
q: Electronic publication of these documents in a generally accessible manner makes the establishment of an election result more transparent and better verifiable.
Elektronische openbaarmaking van deze documenten op een algemeen toegankelijke wijze zorgt ervoor dat de totstandkoming van de uitslag van een verkiezing transparanter en beter controleerbaar wordt.

parties: Asks whether personal data of voters who objected orally should be legally excluded from the minutes, and what happens to generated tally data in the interim.
Asks which candidate personal data become public through the minutes and whether elections without public candidate names are conceivable for privacy reasons.
Which personal data of candidates are made public in the minutes that were not already published on the candidate lists, the CDA members ask.
Welke persoonsgegevens van kandidaten worden in de processen-verbaal openbaar gemaakt, die niet al eerder openbaar gemaakt zijn op de kandidatenlijsten, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.
Supports transparency but warns that uncorrectable minutes could contain errors and personal data, and asks for a systematic justification of limits on data-protection rights.
According to the D66 members this is undesirable.
Dit is volgens de leden van de D66-fractie onwenselijk.
Asks whether it is legally guaranteed that published results cannot be challenged successfully, e.g. on the validity of municipal decisions taken by one vote.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill on electronic publication of polling-station results may proceed, but asked for justification or amendment on publishing per-polling-station totals and on how authenticity is shown without publishing signatures. The government's reply accepts the need for rules on digitally generated per-station results (deferred to a separate bill), keeps signatures off the internet while allowing inspection at town hall, rejects the VNG's view on added workload, and makes technical and kiescollege corrections.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the bill explicitly require digital publication of per-polling-station results; the government agrees in principle but defers this to a separate bill with rules on authenticity and tamper-proofing.

The Afdeling asked the explanation to address how authenticity of published scans can be shown without signatures; the government adds that town-hall inspection of full copies preserves verifiability.

The Afdeling asked the explanation to substantiate the feasibility of the short timeframe and the financial effects for municipalities, which the VNG disputed; the government rejects the VNG's workload view and adds cost estimates.
Redactional changes to the explanatory memorandum and a corrected cross-reference, plus an added rule on preference-vote threshold for kiescollege elections, were made.

35110.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2017/1852 on tax dispute resolution mechanisms by creating a complaint procedure, a mutual agreement procedure, and a mandatory arbitration commission for double-taxation disputes between EU member states. It assigns the Minister of Finance as competent authority and sets deadlines, settlement agreements, confidentiality and publication rules, and transitional provisions.
35110.j: The memorandum justifies the procedural design by the directive's requirements and the need for speed and efficiency in resolving disputes.
q: Depending on whether the complaint was rejected by one or all member states, the bill creates a possibility for the taxpayer to request an arbitration commission or to initiate an objection and appeal procedure in the Netherlands.

Het wetsvoorstel creëert, afhankelijk van de omstandigheid of de klacht door één of alle lidstaten is afgewezen, een mogelijkheid voor de belanghebbende om te verzoeken om een arbitragecommissie in te stellen of in Nederland een bezwaar- en beroepsprocedure te initiëren.
d: rules on contacts with Commission, other authority and arbitration commission
working rules of the arbitration commission agreed by ministers
p: The Minister may unilaterally settle a dispute within six months, with no appeal against that decision.
No appeal lies against the Minister's decision to accept or reject a complaint, though the Minister must give reasons for rejection.
The Minister may refuse access to the arbitration commission or suspend procedures, with no appeal against either decision.

parties: Asks about the complaint procedure, time limits and appeal options under the proposed law compared with the General State Taxes Act, and about the scope of arbitration.
These members are positive that stakeholders can enforce arbitration to prevent lengthy dispute settlement.
Deze leden zijn positief over het feit dat belanghebbenden arbitrage kunnen afdwingen om langlopende geschillenbeslechting te voorkomen.

Supports the law as strengthening taxpayers' means to act against double taxation, but asks whether natural persons without an adviser are adequately informed and whether member states could use delay tactics.
This law strengthens the existing possibilities and these members welcome that.
Deze wet is een versterking van de bestaande mogelijkheden en dat juichen deze leden toe.

Asks about the independence of arbitration commission members, the role of the taxpayer in procedures, publication of final decisions and the lack of precedent, and whether a fiscal judge must sit on the commission.
These members ask whether the government intends to draft a template for summaries of final decisions.
Deze leden vragen of de regering voornemens is om een sjabloon op te stellen voor samenvattingen van eindbesluiten.
Asks why costs are not charged to unsuccessful complainants, whether companies have incentives to litigate, and why full publication of final decisions is not always required.
Why does the government not recover costs from the stakeholder if the complaint is rightly rejected, ask the GroenLinks members.
Waarom verhaalt de regering de kosten niet op de belanghebbende in het geval de klacht terecht wordt afgewezen, vragen de leden van de fractie van GroenLinks.

Doubts the necessity of the bill, fears governments could be stalled by stakeholders, asks how independence of the arbitration commission is guaranteed, and asks that arbitration be limited to double taxation matters.
They also wonder whether stakeholders can unnecessarily turn to the arbitration commission and whether governments can thereby be stalled.
Ook vragen zij zich af of er nodeloos door belanghebbenden naar de arbitragecommissie kan worden gestapt en of overheden hierdoor kunnen worden getraineerd.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on 5 December 2018, that it had no remarks on the draft bill introducing a statutory mechanism for resolving tax disputes between EU Member States (Wet fiscale arbitrage) and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris van Financiën's reply of 13 December 2018 notes that only redactional changes and a technical adjustment to the start date of the mutual agreement procedure were made.

35200-IIA.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for 2018 by adjusting appropriations across several articles, including the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint budget items. It is a budgetary adjustment (slotwet) with the figures set out in an attached statement, effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35470-J.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement (Slotwet) of the Deltafonds, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across its articles to reflect the realised figures. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, accounting changes or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

35570-I.s: The bill formally adopts the 2021 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the King (Begroting I), setting out appropriations of about 45.7 million euro for grondwettelijke uitkeringen, functional expenditure and charged costs of other budgets. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes it effective from 1 January 2021.
q: The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2021 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2021 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) and found no remarks on the bills, apart from one non-blank opinion on the Ministry of Finance budget. The government's nader rapport replies that the non-blank opinion is addressed in an annex and notes some budget amendments.
concerns: The Afdeling raised remarks on the Ministry of Finance budget bill, which the government addresses only in an annex not included in the text.

35650-J.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Delta Fund (Deltafonds) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across several articles for projects such as the Markermeerdijk and Afsluitdijk. The explanatory memorandum explains the budget shifts by project and ministry, and the bill does not itself delegate rule-making or shift powers away from parliament or courts.
35650-J.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by project delays, accelerations and overbookings, with no justification for delegated or new executive powers.
q: This is largely caused by the Markermeerdijk Hoorn-Edam-Amsterdam project.
Dit wordt grotendeels veroorzaakt door het project Markermeerdijk Hoorn-Edam-Amsterdam.

35830-J.s: This bill (Slotwet 2020) amends the 2020 budget statement of the Deltafonds by adjusting appropriations, expenditures and receipts across its articles to match the realised figures. It contains only technical budget adjustments and bookkeeping changes, with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
35830-J.j: The explanatory memorandum says only technical execution changes, bookkeeping changes and changes from control findings are included.
q: This bill includes only technical implementation changes, changes of an accounting nature, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

35975-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2021.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation for the year 2021
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenweking voor het jaar 2021

36001.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality by adding €25.5 million to article 21 (agriculture) for an incidental regulation covering unavoidable fixed costs and water damage in Limburg. It takes effect on 1 January 2022, or retroactively from that date if published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) of the 2022 budget statement
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV), van de begrotingsstaat, voor het jaar 2022

36010.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adding a third incidental supplementary budget for COVID-19 measures of about 252 million euros in additional spending. The amendment is effective from 14 January 2022 and is enacted by the Crown with the advice of the Council of State.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2022

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2022

36100-IIA.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Dutch States General (House of Representatives and Senate) by adjusting appropriations and expenditures across its policy articles. It sets figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2021
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2021

36350-L.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the National Growth Fund (Nationaal Groeifonds), mainly reducing commitments and expenditure on research and development and innovation by about 170 million euros and knowledge development by about 1.3 million euros, with a first supplementary budget effective from 1 June 2023. It is a budget-adjustment law with no delegation of rule-making power, and the explanatory memorandum merely tabulates the fund's allocation status.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the National Growth Fund (L) for the year 2023 (First supplementary budget)
Wijziging begrotingsstaat van het Nationaal Groeifonds (L) voor het jaar 2023 (Eerste suppletoire begroting)

36360-K.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (Hoofdstuk K) through a closing budget adjustment (slotwet), recording actual commitments, expenditures and receipts against the original and supplementary budgets. It consists of budget figures and technical budget adjustments rather than new substantive powers.
q: The bill contains technical implementation changes, accounting-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

36470-I.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the King (I) by adjusting the budget lines, with a total increase of 29 thousand euros in Article 3 (doorbelaste uitgaven van andere begrotingen), mainly a cost pass-through for information management under the Open Government programme. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively from 1 December 2023.
q: This concerns a pass-through of the price adjustment for information management within the Open Government programme for the King's Cabinet.
Dit betreft een doorbelasting van de prijsbijstelling voor informatiehuishouding in het kader van het programma Open Overheid voor het Kabinet van de Koning.

36550-J.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (first supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across articles on water safety, freshwater supply, operations and maintenance, experiments under the Delta Act, and water quality. It also sets the amendment's effective date retroactively to 1 June 2024.

36560-I.s: This bill adopts the final adjustment (slotwet) to the 2023 departmental budget of the King's household (begrotingsstaat van De Koning I), recording realised expenditure against the estimates and the mutations from the first and second supplementary budgets and Prinsjesdag. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.

36613-J.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, adjusting spending and commitment figures across seven articles in the first and September supplementary budgets. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 17 September 2024.
q: The budget statement of the Deltafonds (J) for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds (J) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36740-I.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) that amends the 2024 departmental budget of the King (I), recording final budget mutations and realised figures for the Royal House's constitutional allowances, functional expenditure and charged expenditure. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
36740-I.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget adjustments by reference to collective wage agreements and consumer price index developments, without any new powers.
q: Taking into account the budget changes in the September supplementary budget, the higher realisation of €148 thousand is almost entirely due to the higher consumer price index (CPI) of Statistics Netherlands.

Rekening houdend met de begrotingsmutaties bij de suppletoire begroting september is de hogere realisatie van € 148 duizend vrijwel geheel het gevolg van de hogere consumentenprijsindex (CPI) van het CBS.

36800-L.s: The bill sets the 2026 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Nationaal Groeifonds, specifying appropriations in thousands of euros for policy articles on knowledge development and research, development and innovation. The explanatory memorandum describes budget shifts, conditional and definitive allocations to individual NGF projects, and budget flexibility figures.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Nationaal Groeifonds and advised submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport transmits the advisory batch and notes that some budgets require amendments set out in annexes.

36820-J.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Delta Fund (Deltafonds), adjusting appropriations and expenditure across its budget articles through the first supplementary budget and a September supplementary budget. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and makes the amended statement effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 16 September 2025.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Delta Fund (J) for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds (J) voor het jaar 2025

36945-B.s: This bill is a slotwet that amends the 2025 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), recording supplementary budget mutations and closing budget figures. It sets the commitment amounts for the general, supplementary, integration and decentralisation grants for 2025 and makes the law retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the municipal fund (B) for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van gemeentefonds (B) voor het jaar 2025
